Synopsis:
    BYD recorded its fourth consecutive month of global sales growth in August, with total volumes up 17.8% YoY and exports surging 134.5% YoY. International revenues surpassed domestic revenues for the first time in H1. The company is expanding manufacturing in Brazil with a locally produced PHEV, while domestic profitability remains under pressure from intense competition in China's saturated EV market.
